name: Warcraft Reborn Mystic Enchant Rush of Blood counts Hemorrhages and frees Ambush from Stealth and position
contract: Rush of Blood 1587050 (enchant 1236001): "Ambush has no positional requirement versus monsters and costs 10 less energy. Using Hemorrhage twice in a row makes your next Ambush usable outside Stealth. Using Hemorrhage a third time regenerates 30 energy. Using any other ability resets the sequence." Reported in #10890: it never procced.

It had no spell_proc row and no script, so nothing counted Hemorrhages, and its ignore-positional aura (334) had no handler. Now every ability the rogue casts is seen: the second Hemorrhage in a row gives 1587051 (next Ambush outside Stealth), the third casts 1587057 (+30 energy), anything else resets the count, and Ambush spends 1587051. Aura 334 lets an affected spell skip SPELL_FAILED_NOT_BEHIND, versus monsters only when its MiscValue is 1.

Checked: Ambush's 40 energy cost, no buff after one Hemorrhage, the buff after two, +30 energy on the third, Ambush hitting from the dummy's front without Stealth and spending the buff, Ambush failing again without the buff, and Sinister Strike between Hemorrhages resetting the sequence.
